in_sanskrit.name: चाया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The concept of Chaya in Hinduism refers to the shadow, the illusion, or the reflection of a physical object. It symbolizes the transient nature of material existence and the underlying reality of the spiritual self.

in_hindi.name: चाया
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Chaya translates to Shadow, Illusion, or Reflection. It reflects the idea of the fleeting nature of material existence and the deeper reality of the soul.

in_tamil.name: சாய
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Chaya means Shadow. It is a simple yet profound name that carries the essence of the fleeting nature of physical existence.

in_telugu.name: చాయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Chaya means Shadow. It is a name that carries the essence of the transient nature of physical existence and the underlying reality of the spiritual self.

in_marathi.name: Chaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaya is derived from the Sanskrit word चया (chaya) which means 'shadow' or 'illusion'. In Hindu mythology, Chaya is the goddess of shadows and is often depicted as a reflection or an echo of reality. She is also associated with creativity and imagination.
